title: ThoughtSpot Search and Pinboard Errors
dataSources: MicroStrategy DSSErrors/statistics, Cognos audit database via DB Connect, BusinessObjects Auditing/CMS logs, Oracle Analytics usage tracking, ThoughtSpot audit logs, QuickSight CloudTrail and SPICE CloudWatch metrics.
app: MicroStrategy / IBM Cognos / SAP BusinessObjects / Oracle Analytics / ThoughtSpot / Amazon QuickSight logs via Universal Forwarder, vendor admin APIs, and cloud provider TAs (`Splunk_TA_aws` for QuickSight).
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=thoughtspot:audit (event=answer_error OR event=liveboard_error)
| stats count as errors by user_name, error_type
| where errors>0
| sort - errors
description: Captures ThoughtSpot search and Liveboard errors so failed queries against the underlying warehouse are caught quickly.
value: ThoughtSpot errors block natural-language analytics for users; error visibility speeds resolution and protects adoption.
implementation: Ingest ThoughtSpot audit logs; schedule hourly; alert on error spikes.
visualization: Table by error type/user, timechart of errors.
grandmaExplanation: We catch errors in ThoughtSpot searches and boards so users are not left with broken answers.
